'''Kalas-Na''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was part of the group of Voss that left the planet as part of the entourage for the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Gaden-Ko]], traveling with him on [[the Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette]]. Kalas-Na and his commandos participated in the assault on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Harrower-class)|''Javelin'']]<ref name="SWTOR" /> and later assisted in liberating the [[Guardian Holds]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="SWTOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Old Blood|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kalas-Na appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Jedi Consular class mission on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWTOR2" />
